verdict.rationale: Self-hosting is a fair question for a transactional email service, so the axis applies. The evidence describes only a hosted SaaS: the API, SMTP relay and remote MCP endpoint all run on MailerSend's infrastructure, and pricing is plan-based. Nothing shows a self-hostable or on-premise deployment of the core product, and the MCP server is not the core product.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can self-host the core product
